human_review_text: The paper introduces EmerNeRF, an approach for learning spatial-temporal representations of dynamic scenes. EmerNeRF decomposes scenes into static and dynamic fields, with an additional scene flow field modeling the movement of objects across time. The dynamic feature is computed as a weighted sum of features from nearby timesteps, where the sampling operation is determined by the self-supervised scene flow field. Additionally, the paper proposes a method to generate positional encoding (PE) free features from a pretrained feature encoder by leveraging the time-consistent property of PE features. The empirical result indicates the proposed method can achieve better novel view synthesis, flow estimation, and few-shot semantic prediction results compared to the baselines.
